text_span: Standard QAOA uses a transverse field mixer HX = P Xi which flips single spins, violating the constraint P Xi = K.
rationale: Explains why the standard mixer is unsuitable for the constrained problem.

text_span: We initialize the system in the Dicke state |DK N ⟩, an equal superposition of all computational basis states with Hamming weight K
